description: Straßenbeleuchtung#FOR#EDIT is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by gdi-hok.de. The street lights and cables are used to maintain and manage the stock of street lights and lighting cables within the city of Forchtenberg. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Street lighting #FOR #EDIT" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Brenndauer, Zustand, Leitungen der Straßenbeleuchtung, Stadt Forchtenberg, Inbetriebnahme, Halbnachtbetrieb. The listing shows 2025-11-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
